authorization.scope: One fresh generation of the same breakbeat brief, followed by local David comparison preview if successful.

retry_of.billing_status: The failed generation response lists this price, but no debit/refund confirmation is exposed. Do not treat as verified net charge.

prompt: An original 18-second instrumental cyberpunk big-beat/electro-funk advertising jingle at 160 BPM in 4/4, exuberant, cocky and fast, with crisp syncopated breakbeat drums, a rubbery distorted synth-bass riff, bright staccato analog synth/brass stabs, and a catchy three-note lead motif repeated with playful call-and-response. Hit the groove immediately, keep the central arrangement clean and spacious for a low spoken announcer, then use a quick half-beat stop and a bigger return of the same hook in the final four seconds, ending on a tight two-hit bass/synth signature with a short clean tail. Completely instrumental with no singing, speech, chants, choirs or vocal samples; no long build, no slow section and no busy solo.

parameters.name: lyrics_type
parameters.description: How lyrics are handled: auto-generated, custom-provided, or instrumental only.

parameters.name: lyrics
parameters.description: Custom lyrics text or a reference to a text node's output. Ignored when lyrics_type is 'instrumental'.

creative_direction.user_request: I like it. Can we experiment with another jingle? surprise me!
creative_direction.retained_constraints: Instrumental, fast/upbeat, starts after So upgrade; use locked David narration. Preserve liked metal candidate and its raised-volume preview.
creative_direction.assistant_choices: 18 seconds, target 160 BPM, cyberpunk big beat/electro-funk, syncopated drums and bass, recurring three-note synth hook, contrasting sound, clean ending.
creative_direction.reference_usage: Original descriptive prompt only; no reference song supplied or sampled.

review.checks: Native MP3 downloaded, hash recorded, afinfo inspected and audio decoded successfully; separate comparison preview rendered.
review.requested_direction: Cyberpunk big beat/electro-funk, target 160 BPM and recurring hook; these are prompt specifications, not measured tempo or assistant listening findings.
review.instrumental: Both instrumental controls enabled, no lyrics; absence of vocal artifacts awaits user listening.
review.comparison: Same David source, voice gain, master gain and 4.36s entrance; approximate source RMS matching followed by a 0.1 dB music-only reduction to satisfy sample-peak guard. Not perceptual LUFS matching.
review.local_render_note: Initial configuration failed fixed-master peak guard at -0.493919 dBFS and wrote no preview. Lowered music envelope by 0.1 dB, then rendered successfully at -0.503647 dBFS. No extra provider generation.
review.publication: No final music-share publication or contest submission.
